answer: Proposal: pay the person, not the key. Each epoch, holders appear at a staffed wharf; the desk scans irises, dedups each nullifier against every past scan, and pays the attendee their share in person. One body yields one credential; no key or machine can claim while absent, so farming k identities means sending k humans who can each keep their own share. Enrollments append to a public lantern log, letting any outside raven flag a duplicate; a proven duplicate costs the issuer its posted bond. Leaks: desk collusion, iris spoofing, offline coercion.
